title: Causal Manifestation
next_chapter_hook: While Chen Ji was still savoring that fourth possibility, hurried footsteps came from outside the hall—Su Qingyao burst in drenched in blood, clutching a blood-stained ancient jade in her hand: "Chen Ji, your scheme... has been discovered by Ling Yuan!"

text.content: The moment Chen Ji's fingertips touched that invitation, the causal threads of the entire Three Realms trembled slightly. He didn't immediately make a choice, but closed his eyes, letting his four-dimensional perception fully unfold. In an instant, the river of time reversed before him, every key node of the past transforming into brilliant points of light, connecting into an enormous web of fate. And he, Chen Ji, stood at the very center of this web, commanding the convergence of all threads.

He saw himself three years ago, kneeling in the mud of the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters, being trampled by others. At that time, no one knew that the empty-eyed waste of a disciple had a mind rapidly running a chess game sufficient to overturn the Three Realms. The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea burned slightly, and each glimpse of three hours into the future cost five years of his lifespan. But he never regretted, because what he wanted was not temporary satisfaction, but the final reversal.

The first light exploded at the western horizon, that being the direction of the Xuanwu Sect. Within that light was reflected a scene: Chen Ji draped in dark robes, seated at the apex of the chessboard dominating the Three Realms, with all the strong ones groveling at his feet. He saw no joy on his own face, only endless loneliness and exhaustion. This path was called the "Chess Player's Path"—the cost was abandoning all emotional bonds, becoming a truly heartless chess master. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul whispered in his ear: "On this path, you will lose Su Qingyao, lose Chen Nian, lose everyone, leaving only eternal victory."

dialogue.content: "This path seems glorious, but in truth it is merely infinitely expanding the chessboard of the Heavenly Eye. You may manipulate countless pieces for billions of years, yet ultimately you are just a larger piece on the board." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried desolation, "Throughout history, at least seventy percent of the Tianji Record's inheritors chose this path, none met a good end."

text.content: The second light suddenly blazed, with a blood-red hue of the Demonic Path. In the scene, Chen Ji stood shoulder to shoulder with Ye Qing, behind them were the toppled three major sects and the burning Holy Land, the will of the Heavenly Eye roared angrily in the Void. This path was called the "Path of Freedom"—the cost was a complete binding with the Demonic Path, dragging the Three Realms into an unprecedented era of chaos. Ye Qing's figure was especially clear in the scene, her eyes glistening with tears.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gazed at Ye Qing in the scene, suddenly showing a bitter smile: "If I take this path, her Demonic Path mist will forever shroud the Tianji Record's aura, preventing the Heavenly Eye from directly peering. But the Three Realms would fall into a century of chaos, with countless deaths—far more than billions? This is not the freedom I want; it is a shortcut built on the blood of innocents."

text.content: The third light was the most striking, pitch-black like ink, almost devouring all light. In the scene, both Chen Ji and the Heavenly Eye turned to nothingness, all causal threads of the Three Realms shattered, and even Heaven itself stopped functioning in that instant. This path was called "Mutual Destruction"—the cost was him returning to oblivion along with this world, never to be reborn. The Heavenly Fate consumption in the scene surged madly, finally定格 at a shocking number: 999,999 points.

Chen Ji stared at that number, then suddenly burst into hearty laughter. His laughter echoed in the empty Mental Sea, carrying an indescribable madness: "Mutual destruction? I, Chen Ji, schemed for three years, endured humiliation, advanced steadily—only to die alongside this damned Heaven? Ridiculous! I haven't yet personally overturned the chessboard, haven't rescued Chen Nian, haven't seen the despair on Ling Yuan's old face—why should I die!"

dialogue.content: The laughter stopped abruptly, his gaze regaining clarity, though a hint of unprecedented wavering deep in his eyes. He murmured to himself: "But... if all three paths are dead ends, what should I do? I, Chen Ji, can scheme flawlessly, yet cannot calculate through this damned fate."

choice.prompt: Just as Chen Ji fell into unprecedented confusion, a familiar yet strange voice came from the depths of his Mental Sea—it was Chen Nian's voice, yet not quite, carrying an ethereal quality beyond time and space. "Brother, you forgot. You still have one path, one even the Tianji Record dares not reveal."

choices.text: Inquire about the detailed costs of the Chess Master's Path
choices.description: As an infallible schemer, Chen Ji must thoroughly quantify the pros and cons of each path, even if it means abandoning emotions.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete analysis of the Chess Master's Path consequences
choices.risk_hint: Choosing this path means you will bid farewell to warmth forever

text.content: The Tianji Record's pages flipped madly, countless ancient runes appearing, finally converging into a clear scene: Chen Ji sat atop the pinnacle of nothingness, surrounded by countless causal threads, the figures of Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and Chen Nian gradually blurring and vanishing at the edges of the scene. His face showed no sorrow, only absolute rationality and coldness. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again: "This is the Chess Master's destiny—when you step onto the chessboard, all pieces become unrelated to you."

choices.text: Inquire about the risks of the Freedom Path
choices.description: Cooperating with the Demonic Path is a double-edged sword, and Chen Ji must assess whether Ye Qing is truly worth trusting with his back.
choices.visible_reward: Unlock Ye Qing's hidden cooperation motives
choices.risk_hint: Demonic Path allies may turn against you at any moment

text.content: In the scene, Ye Qing's face appeared, her eyes bearing a determination Chen Ji had never seen. "Chen Ji, do you know why I'm willing to cooperate with you? Because in the prophecy the Tianji Record showed me, there's a sentence—'Only by standing shoulder to shoulder with you can the Holy Sect's chains be broken.' I'm not helping you; I'm saving myself." Her voice carried a sorrowful chill, "But if you continue down this path, you'll become a public enemy of the entire Three Realms, never able to turn back."

choices.description: Chen Nian's voice gave Chen Ji a glimmer of hope, but this path held too many unknowns, with both cost and reward being uncertainties.
choices.risk_hint: The unknown path may be more dangerous than the known deadly trap

text.content: Chen Ji's four-dimensional perception shuddered violently, and a golden light point never seen before emerged in his Mental Sea. Chen Nian's figure gradually became clear within that light—she was no longer the girl who needed protection from his memories, but an existence emanating mysterious aura. "Brother, the Tianji Record is a chess piece of the Heavenly Eye, but the source of the Tianji Record—the part deliberately hidden by generations of inheritors—does not belong to Heaven's Way." Her voice echoed in the depths of Chen Ji's consciousness, "Find it, and you can find the power to overturn the chessboard."
Chen Ji猛地睁开眼睛，四维感知的视野中，那道金色光点正在crazed跳动，仿佛有生命一般。他终于明白了什么——天机录不只是一本预言之书，它的真正核心被历代传承者刻意封印，因为那里面藏着连天道之眼都fearful的东西。但陈念是怎么知道的？她一个被圣宗掳走的普通少女，为何能触及这终极的秘密？

dialogue.content: "哥，你还记得我们小时候的事吗？"陈念的声音在陈机脑海中响起，带着一丝追忆的gentle，"那次你发高烧，差点死了。我在你床边守了三天三夜，迷迷糊糊中听到一个声音说——'此女与天机有缘，可为锁钥'。从那一刻起，我的命运就和天机录绑在了一起。只是我一直不明白，那个声音的主人……到底想做什么。"

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. 天命锁钥——he一直以为那只是圣宗用来threatening陈念的借口，却从未深想过这四个字背后的含义。如果陈念真的与天机录有着某种本源性的联系，那她被圣宗带走就不是偶然，而是某种更大棋局的一部分。是谁在下这盘棋？天道之眼？天机录的源头？还是那个从未露面的墨先生背后的存在？

choice.prompt: 就在陈机陷入pensive时，四维感知的视野中忽然捕捉到一道异常——在三大命运之路之外，有一条若隐若现的灰线，正从凌渊所在的方向延伸而出，与天道之眼的意志若即若离地交织在一起。这意味着什么？

choices.description: Ling Yuan与天道之眼的关系绝非表面那么简单，这可能是破局的关键突破口。
choices.visible_reward: 发现凌渊隐藏的惊天秘密
choices.risk_hint: 打草惊蛇可能让凌渊提前动手

text.content: 灰线在四维视野中逐渐放大，陈机看到了令他背脊发凉的一幕——凌渊的识海深处，赫然存在着一道与天道之眼同源的气息，那不是简单的合作，而是一种……共生关系。Mo Xiansheng的声音突然变得grave："原来如此，凌渊不是天道之眼的棋子，而是它投放的一个分身。他根本不是人，或者说，早就不是人了。"

choices.description: Chen Nian的出现让Chen Ji看到了新的希望，他决定将所有筹码都押在这条未知的路上。
choices.visible_reward: 解锁天机录源头的关键线索
choices.risk_hint: 过度消耗可能让陈机陷入weak

text.content: Chen Ji将所有意识灌注向那道金色光点，四维视野abruptly炸开，无数画面如潮水般涌入他的识海——那是天机录创世之初的景象，鸿蒙之中有一道意志在沉睡，它既不是天道，也不是天道之眼，而是凌驾于一切之上的'天机本源'。天机录不过是它的一个碎片，而陈念，正是唤醒它的最后一把钥匙。但唤醒需要代价——一个与天机录命运绑定之人的全部记忆与情感。
Chen Ji's脸色suddenly苍白。那个代价意味着什么？意味着他将失去所有关于苏青瑶的记忆，失去对陈念的兄妹之情，失去三年布局中积累的一切羁绊与情感。届时唤醒天机本源的那个人，将不再是Chen Ji，而是一具只有目的没有温度的空壳。这真的是他想要的吗？

dialogue.content: Chen Ji闭上眼睛，脑海中飞速闪过无数画面。苏青瑶在月下舞剑的背影、夜清第一次展露的脆弱笑容、陈念小时候拉着他衣角叫哥哥的模样……这些是他三年来支撑下去的全部理由。如果失去这些，就算推翻了天道之眼，他Chen Ji还是Chen Ji吗？"took note of this。"他murmured自语，声音里带着一丝从未有过的颤抖，"这个仇，我took note of this。等我找到第四条路，我会把今天感受到的fearful、wavering、软弱，全部还给这该死的命运。"

choice.prompt: 四维视野中的三条命运之路仍在缓缓旋转，金色的第四种可能却如风中残烛般摇曳不定。Chen Ji必须做出最终的决定——是选择已知的代价，还是赌一把未知的可能？

choices.description: Since emotions are a burden, then sever them completely. Chen Ji will become the true master of the Three Realms' chessboard in the coldest possible manner.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the power to control the karma of the Three Realms
choices.risk_hint: This path has no return, and the final outcome remains the destiny of a pawn

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's finger hovered over the invitation, then suddenly let out a cold laugh: "The path of a chess player? Sounds beautiful, but I don't like having my ending arranged by others. Even if that ending was my own choice, it is still unacceptable." His four-dimensional vision suddenly contracted, and all the points of light in his eyes turned to nothingness, "The thing I hate most in this life is a grid drawn by someone else."

choices.description: The unknown path, though dangerous, still holds hope. Chen Ji decided to take a gamble, using his own wisdom to carve out a path even the heavens didn't anticipate.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the possibility of subverting the chessboard
choices.risk_hint: This path has no reference whatsoever, and any misstep means utter destruction

text.content: An unprecedented light blazed in Chen Ji's eyes. He did not touch any of the invitations, but instead closed his eyes, completely withdrawing his four-dimensional perception, condensing it into a single point - the direction where Chen Nian was. "Little Nian, since you could speak of a fourth possibility, it means you have a way. Brother believes in you." His voice was calm yet resolute, "I will find you. Until then, I will pave this road for you in my own way."

The moment Chen Ji made his decision, the entire Mental Sea suddenly quivered. The cover of the Tianji Record opened on its own, revealing the final page - which should have been blank, but now displayed a line of ancient characters: "Karma has emerged, the chess game shall change. Chen Ji, your choice has been recorded upon the Heavenly Dao. From this moment, the karma of the Three Realms will alter its course because of you alone." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a rare hint of relief: "Finally... Finally someone has not chosen those three dead ends. Lad, you are stronger than this master anticipated."

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, withdrawing his four-dimensional perception from the Mental Sea and returning to the senses of reality. He found himself still standing in place, finger suspended in mid-air, the invitation's glow flickering at his fingertips. He took a deep breath, suppressing all the chaotic thoughts below, and a familiar curve appeared at the corner of his mouth - that was the unique smile one wore when pretending to be weak before devouring the strong. "Three dead ends?" he murmured, "What Chen Ji does best is breathe life into dead ends. Since the Tianji Record dares to give me multiple choice questions, I'll give it a proof problem instead - proving that there is no so-called predetermined destiny in this world."

But just then, urgent footsteps suddenly echoed outside the hall, accompanied by the roar of spiritual energy fluctuation. Chen Ji's expression instantly grew solemn - he knew this spiritual energy fluctuation frequency all too well; it was the characteristic of the Tianqing Sect's protective mountain formation being forcibly torn apart. Someone had invaded his secluded cultivation place! His divine sense instantly extended outward, catching a familiar figure rushing toward him while covered in blood. Su Qingyao, her white garments already soaked through with blood, clutching tightly a bloodstained ancient jade, her eyes filled with anxiety and fear - this was the first time Chen Ji had seen such an expression on her face in three years.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao's voice was hoarse and urgent, she stumbled to Chen Ji's front, grabbing his lapel, "Your layout... Ling Yuan discovered it! An hour ago he convened all the elders, saying he would publicly expose you as an insider of the Heavenly Eye! Han Lie has already surrounded the entire mountain peak, we... we have no time!" The ancient jade in her hand suddenly blazed with blinding light, and an old yet majestic voice emerged from within: "Chen Ji, did you think hiding here would let you escape this old man's palm? How naive."

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at Su Qingyao's pale face and the crisscrossing wounds on her body, a trace of killing intent flickering in his eyes. His voice was terrifyingly calm: "Who did this?" Su Qingyao bit her lip, a hint of emotion flashing in her eyes: "It was Ling Yuan's personal disciple, he said... he said waste products don't deserve to live in the sect, dying is what they deserve." Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile was so gentle it made one's hair stand on end: "Alright, noted. After the matter with Ling Yuan is dealt with, I'll let that person know what it means to suffer worse than death." He reached out and brushed across Su Qingyao's wounds, a wisp of gentle spiritual energy flowing in, "Senior Sister Su, rest for now. Next, let the professional handle it."
